name: BeiDou (北斗)
best_known_for: China's GNSS — 30+ satellites mixing MEO (21,500 km), IGSO (35,786 km inclined), GEO; full global coverage declared 2020; only GNSS with short-message satellite communication built in
credit: CNSA + China Satellite Navigation Office BeiDou-3 system. Spans MEO (24 sats) + IGSO (3 sats) + GEO (3 sats), unique hybrid architecture.
